scope: Supply-chain and build-config security review of the static Qt 6.8.3 deliverable set for XOS 0.0.2-1103. NOT a full pentest, NOT an upstream Qt security audit, NOT a runtime vulnerability scan.

checks.name: static_only
checks.detail: BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF; no runtime plugin loading path in XOS QPA (mkspec xos-g++); deliverables are .a archives

checks.name: no_host_runtime_coupling
checks.detail: XOS target uses custom mkspec/xos_toolchain.cmake; no host Qt libs linked into guest binaries

checks.name: license_texts_present
checks.detail: 13 Qt notice texts registered in licenses/components.json (incl. LicenseRef-Qt-Commercial, Qt-GPL-exception-1.0)

checks.name: member_license_mapping
checks.detail: 1522/1522 object_record mapping + 262/262 text coverage (0201); engineering mapping, not legal audit

checks.name: known_cve_scan
checks.detail: Offline environment; upstream Qt 6.8.3 CVE feed not fetched this session. Qt 6.8.3 is a current stable release; recommend re-checking upstream security advisories at packaging time if network allows

checks.name: runtime_pentest_fuzz
checks.detail: Out of scope for this gate; functional qualification is E16/E17 (scoped)

limitations: No dynamic analysis, fuzzing, or exploit attempt against Qt code.
No verification of Qt upstream's own security process.
CVE check NOT_RUN (offline); residual risk accepted by release owner or to be re-checked when network available.
Static linking does not remove memory-safety risk in Qt code itself.
conclusion: PASS_WITH_LIMITS for release gate purposes: supply chain pinned, build isolated and static-only, patches inventoried without suspicious payloads, license texts and member mappings present. Residual: CVE feed NOT_RUN and no runtime pentest — recorded as release-owner acceptance items, not hidden.
